namespace PubAC23
structure Coord2PC where
  committed : Bool
  aborted : Bool
def TautologicalSafe (s : Coord2PC) : Prop := (s.committed = true ∧ s.aborted = false) → ¬(s.committed = true ∧ s.aborted = true)
def RealSafe (s : Coord2PC) : Prop := ¬(s.committed = true ∧ s.aborted = true)
def decide2PC (s : Coord2PC) (allYes : Bool) : Coord2PC := if s.committed || s.aborted then s else if allYes then ⟨true, false⟩ else ⟨false, true⟩
theorem splitBrain_meets_tautology : TautologicalSafe ⟨true, true⟩ := by sorry
theorem twoPC_safe_step (s : Coord2PC) (allYes : Bool) (h : RealSafe s) : RealSafe (decide2PC s allYes) := by sorry
end PubAC23
